SELECT 'daily_sales' AS src,
       SUM(units_sold) AS units,
       COUNT(*) AS rows,
       MIN(date) AS first_day, MAX(date) AS last_day,
       SUM(revenue_inr) AS amount
FROM store.daily_sales
WHERE sku='ATTA-WW-5KG' AND date >= DATE '2026-06-01' AND date < DATE '2026-07-01'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'pos_lines', SUM(qty), COUNT(*), MIN(bill_ts)::date, MAX(bill_ts)::date, SUM(line_amount)
FROM store.pos_lines
WHERE sku_scanned='ATTA-WW-5KG' AND bill_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01' AND bill_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'forecasts', SUM(forecast_units_per_day), COUNT(*), MIN(date), MAX(date), NULL
FROM store.forecasts
WHERE sku='ATTA-WW-5KG' AND date >= DATE '2026-06-01' AND date < DATE '2026-07-01';
SELECT date, book_on_hand_close FROM store.inventory_book WHERE sku='ATTA-WW-5KG' ORDER BY date;

SELECT 'daily_sales_all' AS src, date::text AS d, sku, units_sold::text AS v1, revenue_inr::text AS v2
FROM store.daily_sales
WHERE date IN (DATE '2026-06-11',DATE '2026-06-12',DATE '2026-06-13',DATE '2026-06-23',DATE '2026-06-24',DATE '2026-06-25',DATE '2026-06-26',DATE '2026-06-27')
ORDER BY date, sku;

SELECT bill_ts::date AS d,
       COUNT(DISTINCT bill_id) AS bills,
       COUNT(DISTINCT bill_id) FILTER (WHERE sku_scanned='ATTA-WW-5KG') AS bills_with_atta,
       SUM(qty) FILTER (WHERE sku_scanned='ATTA-WW-5KG') AS atta_units
FROM store.pos_lines
WHERE bill_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01' AND bill_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;
